events.what_it_is: DedCool's first cafe and retail pop-up, celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe drinks, fragrance sampling and exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 guests in line each day; other gifts may be purchase-linked.
events.caveats: The host Partiful page accepts RSVPs, while current event guidance describes the pop-up as open to walk-ins. The first-50 gift is supply- and arrival-order-dependent; do not imply every attendee receives one.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20, 9 AM-6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street.

events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with product consultations, games, prizes, an immersive installation and a chance to meet founder Sarah Cheung.
events.what_is_free: A full-size product is advertised for attendees while supplies last, plus games and prizes. Separate gifts with purchase require a qualifying recent Ulta Beauty SACHEU receipt.
events.caveats: The published fine print explicitly says RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance, or a reserved place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Products and promotional items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20, 11 AM-5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St. RSVP is for communications/planning rather than guaranteed admission.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street and 9th Avenue, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: One-day outdoor KILIAN PARIS activation celebrating the brand's Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last. Exclusive gifts are tied to purchase.
events.caveats: Current listings explicitly describe the activation as open to the public. Complimentary mocktails and samples are while supplies last; gifts with purchase are not free-no-purchase giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, noon-8 PM at Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street and 9th Avenue.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: Dunkin' sampling truck at Pier 17 serving seasonal drinks and promotional swag.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples and swag are explicitly supply-limited. No advance RSVP requirement is published for the truck activation.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 2:30-6 PM at Pier 17 in the Seaport.

events.event_name: KIKO Milano SoHo Free Product Giveaway
events.what_it_is: A two-day promotional giveaway at KIKO Milano's new permanent SoHo flagship.
events.what_is_free: A free product for the first 200 people on Friday Sept. 18 and Saturday Sept. 19, with no purchase necessary. Promotional free engraving is also advertised for visitors holding the distributed Bring a Friend card.
events.caveats: The free-product offer is limited to the first 200 people each day and is not guaranteed for later arrivals. This is a promotion at a permanent store, not a temporary store opening.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 and Saturday Sept. 19 at 430 W Broadway. Friday listing shows 10 AM-8 PM; Saturday uses the flagship's published Saturday 10 AM-8 PM store hours.
